docs.title: Home
docs.text:
ProfileStoreTyped v1.0.0

ProfileStore already won session locking, mock stores, and shutdown saves. This wrapper does not replace that engine. It makes Profile.Data a real T from one options table.

export type Data = {
    Coins: number,
    Items: { string },
}

local PlayerData = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.ProfileStoreTyped)({
    StoreName = "PlayerData",
    Data = {
        Coins = 0,
        Items = {},
    } :: Data,
    BindPlayers = true,
})

-- Server
local Store = PlayerData.Server()
Store:MutatePlayer(player, function(Data)
    Data.Coins += 10
end)

-- Client
local Replica = PlayerData.Client()
Replica:Observe(function(Data)
    print(Data.Coins)
end)

Same options. Same T. Autocomplete on both sides.

  • ProfileStore

    Session locks, steal / cancel, mock DataStores

  • Typed Data

    Data: T instead of T & JSONAcceptable

  • Replica

    Owning client gets the same snapshot

  • OnJoin

    (Player, Data: T) when the session starts

docs.title: Session locked. Types unlocked.
docs.text:
A typed tribute to ProfileStore. Same session lock. Real T on the server and the client.

Get started API

docs.title: Module
docs.text:
local ProfileStoreTyped = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.ProfileStoreTyped)

The module is a callback. Pass DataOptions<T> once. You get lazy Server and Client constructors that close over those options.

local Package = ProfileStoreTyped(Options)

Package.Version        -- "1.0.0"
local Store = Package.Server()
local Replica = Package.Client()

Call Server() only on the server. Call Client() only on the client. That keeps ProfileStore from loading in a LocalScript.

docs.title: DataOptions
docs.text: Field Type Default Purpose StoreName string required DataStore name Data T required Template. This is T. Mock boolean? false Use ProfileStore.Mock BindPlayers boolean? false Load / release on join / leave KickOnFail boolean? true Kick if the profile fails to load KickOnSessionEnd boolean? true Kick if the session ends in-game KickMessage string? built-in Override kick text

docs.title: SessionParams
docs.text:
Field Type Purpose Steal boolean? Ignore an existing session lock Cancel (() -> boolean)? Return true to abort the load

LoadPlayerAsync already cancels if the player leaves.

docs.title: Client
docs.text: Package.Client() attaches a typed replica for that StoreName. It is not a DataStore constructor. The server already owns the session.

docs.title: Properties
docs.text: Member Type Notes Data T? Latest replica. nil until the first packet. Key string? Profile key last replicated Changed Signal<T> Fires on every replica

docs.title: Methods
docs.text:
Replica:Get() --> T?
Replica:GetKey() --> string?
Replica:Observe(function(Data: T) end) --> Connection
Replica:Wait(Timeout?) --> T?

Observe fires immediately if a snapshot is already present.

Wait() yields until the first replica. Pass a timeout in seconds to return nil instead of waiting forever.

docs.title: Replication
docs.text:
The server fires ProfileStoreTyped_Replicate with { StoreName, Key, Data }. Multiple stores can live on the client; packets are routed by StoreName.

Client writes do not save. Change data on the server and let the replica land.

docs.title: Getting started
docs.text: Drop the ProfileStoreTyped model into ReplicatedStorage. DataStores still only run on the server. The client module only listens for replicas.

docs.title: 1. Describe the save
docs.text:
-- ReplicatedStorage.PlayerData
export type Data = {
    Coins: number,
    Items: { string },
}

return require(game.ReplicatedStorage.ProfileStoreTyped)({
    StoreName = "PlayerData",
    Data = {
        Coins = 0,
        Items = {},
    } :: Data,
    BindPlayers = true,
})

T is inferred from Data. Require that same module on server and client.

docs.title: 2. Server
docs.text:
local PlayerData = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.PlayerData)
local Store = PlayerData.Server()

Store.OnJoin:Connect(function(Player, Data)
    print(Player.Name, Data.Coins)
end)

Store:MutatePlayer(player, function(Data)
    Data.Coins += 10
end)

BindPlayers = true loads a profile on join and ends it on leave.

docs.title: 3. Client
docs.text:
local PlayerData = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.PlayerData)
local Replica = PlayerData.Client()

Replica:Observe(function(Data)
    print(Data.Coins, Data.Items)
end)

local Snapshot = Replica:Wait(10) -- Data?

Replica.Data is nil until the first replica arrives. Writes on the client do not save.

docs.title: Studio
docs.text:
BindPlayers = true,
Mock = true,

Mock = true uses ProfileStore's in-memory store. No live DataStore calls.

docs.title: Server
docs.text: Package.Server() returns a store. T is the template you passed into the module callback.

docs.title: Properties
docs.text: Member Type Notes Name string Options.StoreName Template T The template table Mock boolean Whether this store is mocked OnJoin Signal<Player, T> Fired after a player session starts OnLeave Signal<Player> Fired when a player session ends

docs.title: Sessions
docs.text:
Store:LoadSessionAsync(Key, Params?) --> Profile<T>?
Store:LoadPlayerAsync(Player, Params?) --> Profile<T>?
Store:GetSession(Key) --> Profile<T>?
Store:GetPlayerSession(Player) --> Profile<T>?
Store:GetData(Key) --> T?
Store:GetPlayerData(Player) --> T?

LoadPlayerAsync keys by UserId, calls AddUserId, and optionally kicks if the session ends.

Profile.Data is T, not T & JSONAcceptable.

docs.title: Writes
docs.text:
Store:Mutate(Key, function(Data) end) --> T?
Store:MutatePlayer(Player, function(Data) end) --> T?
Store:SaveSession(Key)
Store:SavePlayer(Player)
Store:ReplicateSession(Key, Target?)

Mutate runs only if the session is active, then replicates the snapshot to the owning client.

docs.title: Lifecycle
docs.text:
Store:EndSession(Key)
Store:EndPlayer(Player)
Store:BindPlayers()

BindPlayers is idempotent. It is called automatically when Options.BindPlayers == true.

docs.title: ProfileStore passthrough
docs.text:
Store:MessageAsync(Key, Message) --> boolean
Store:ViewAsync(Key, Version?) --> Profile<T>?
Store:RemoveAsync(Key) --> boolean

docs.title: A typed tribute
docs.text:
ProfileStoreTyped is named that way on purpose.

ProfileStore — Mad Studio, loleris — is the persistence engine. Session locks, mock DataStores, auto-save, shutdown flush. The source sits unchanged under Libraries/ProfileStore.

This module is the types and the replica around that engine. If something fails to save, look at ProfileStore first. If autocomplete lies about Data.Coins, look here.

ProfileStore locked the session.
ProfileStoreTyped unlocked the type.

docs.title: Types
docs.text: Exported from the root module and from Types.

docs.title: DataOptions
docs.text:
export type DataOptions<T> = {
    StoreName: string,
    Data: T,
    Mock: boolean?,
    BindPlayers: boolean?,
    KickOnFail: boolean?,
    KickOnSessionEnd: boolean?,
    KickMessage: string?,
}

docs.title: SessionParams
docs.text:
export type SessionParams = {
    Steal: boolean?,
    Cancel: (() -> boolean)?,
}

docs.title: ReplicaPayload
docs.text:
export type ReplicaPayload<T> = {
    StoreName: string,
    Key: string,
    Data: T,
}

docs.title: Profile
docs.text:
Same object ProfileStore returns, with Data kept as T.

export type Profile<T> = {
    Data: T,
    LastSavedData: T,
    FirstSessionTime: number,
    SessionLoadCount: number,
    Session: { PlaceId: number, JobId: string }?,
    UserIds: { number },
    Key: string,
    IsActive: (self: Profile<T>) -> boolean,
    Reconcile: (self: Profile<T>) -> (),
    EndSession: (self: Profile<T>) -> (),
    AddUserId: (self: Profile<T>, user_id: number) -> (),
    Save: (self: Profile<T>) -> (),
}

ProfileStore's own type is Data: T & JSONAcceptable. That intersection wipes field autocomplete. ProfileStoreTyped unwraps it.
